description: Pilot reports (PIREPs). Call with no args for recent US-wide reports (default CONUS box), or pass a station `id` for reports within `distance_nm` of it, or a custom `bbox`.

bbox.description: Bounding box "minLat,minLon,maxLat,maxLon" (default CONUS "20,-130,55,-60" when no id).

distance_nm.description: Radius from `id` in nautical miles (default 200). Only used with `id`.

id.description: Center station for a proximity filter (e.g. "KORD"); reports within distance_nm of it.

name: pirep
title: Pirep
